title: Run Summary
$comment: Semantic rule not enforced here (deferred to the future Python validator): each path present in artifact_refs must resolve to a file that actually exists and whose own task_id/run_id match this document's. Extension (2026-08-06, checkpoint/resume milestone): phases_reused and phases_restarted are optional and present only on a run-summary produced by a resumed run -- phases_reused lists phases whose canonical artifact was loaded from a prior checkpoint without redispatching an agent; phases_restarted lists phases that were incomplete at interruption and were run fresh in this process. Both are absent on an ordinary, non-resumed run. Extension (2026-08-06, memory-loop milestone): memory_loaded/memory_influenced_run/memory_refs_used are optional and, when present, must be produced by harness/orchestrator/memory.py's summarize_memory_events (via live_cli.py's summarize_memory operation), which derives them from the run's own retained policy-events.jsonl (a real memory_loaded event; real memory_applied events) rather than from an unchecked caller assertion. The if/then above gives this a schema-level floor: a run-summary may not claim memory_influenced_run: true while leaving memory_refs_used empty, though it cannot by itself confirm the listed refs correspond to genuine memory_applied events -- that check lives in summarize_memory_events, not in JSON Schema.
